userId.description: Unique identifier of the user (from Auth)

lastReadBook.description: The book name the user last read (e.g. John)

lastReadChapter.description: The chapter number the user last read (e.g. 1)

createdAt.description: When the user profile was created

updatedAt.description: When the user profile was last updated

Bookmark.title: Bookmark
Bookmark.description: A saved/bookmarked bible verse with dynamic highlights and study notes

id.description: Unique identifier of the bookmark (usually formatted as book_chapter_verse)

userId.description: The ID of the user who saved the bookmark

notes.description: Optional custom study notes added by the user

updatedAt.description: When the bookmark was last updated

QuizScore.title: QuizScore
QuizScore.description: A historic theology quiz or memorization studio result scorecard

id.description: Unique identifier of the quiz result

userId.description: The ID of the user who completed the quiz

score.description: The total score achieved (out of 100 or matching points)

quizBook.description: The book name the quiz was scoped on

quizChapter.description: The chapter number the quiz was scoped on

createdAt.description: When the quiz score was achieved

Chapter.title: Chapter
Chapter.description: A database of all processed, contemporary, and personalized easy English translations to enable ultra-fast load profiles

isHighFidelity.description: Whether the chapter was fully modernized

source.description: The source of the chapter generation

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user state details and interface preferences

/users/{userId}/bookmarks/{bookmarkId}.description: Stores saved verses with notes for a specific user

/users/{userId}/quizzes/{quizId}.description: Keeps a digital record of the user's historical quiz achievements

/chapters/{chapterId}.description: Public database of all pregenerated and modernized Bible chapters
